items.title: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents
items.claim: LLM agents exhibit predictable negative timing in sequential trading decisions.

items.title: Deep Hedging Under Realistic Market Frictions: A Regime-Conditional Empirical Study of Dynamic Option Hedging on Bitcoin Options
items.claim: Deep hedging underperforms classical hedging methods on real options data with realistic transaction costs.

items.title: FORESIGHT-9: Prospective and Process-Aware Evaluation of Adaptive Trading Agents
items.claim: A fixed equal-weight policy outperforms adaptive agents in 31 of 36 prospective runs.

items.title: FaVOR: LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Factor Mining via Empirical Validation
items.claim: Automated factor mining optimized purely for returns breaks down across market regimes.

items.title: Ordinal Gates, Cardinal Bets: Matching LLM Confidence to the Financial Decision Operator
items.claim: LLM confidence score portability requires joint optimization with the downstream operator.

items.title: Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models
items.claim: Current relational foundation models cannot handle high-cardinality real-world data without pre-aggregation.
